title: Hotels with a Brooklyn Bridge view: which room to book
metaDescription: Three New York hotels with Brooklyn Bridge view rooms, the exact room category to book at each, and the city view and Manhattan view rooms to skip.
h1: Hotels with a Brooklyn Bridge view, and which room to book
dek: Three hotels in New York City and Brooklyn. For each one we list the exact room category sold with the bridge in view, and the city, Manhattan and Brooklyn view rooms that look elsewhere.
teaser: From a suite named for the bridge to a room named Brooklyn View that does not name the bridge.

faq.q: Which hotels sell rooms with a Brooklyn Bridge view?
faq.a: Of the hotels we checked in October 2026: 1 Hotel Brooklyn Bridge, M Social Hotel New York Downtown and 33 Hotel. Each sells at least one room category with the bridge named in its name or in its own description.

faq.q: Why is a Premier King at M Social not a bridge view?
faq.a: The hotel's own room list names it Premier King - Brooklyn View, not Brooklyn Bridge View. Only the Panoramic Corner King - Brooklyn Bridge View names the bridge at that hotel, so book that name.

faq.q: Does 1 Hotel Brooklyn Bridge sell a room with the bridge in view?
faq.a: Yes. The Bridge Studio Suite is described on the hotel's own page as overlooking the Brooklyn Bridge, and the Neighboring Bridge Suite & King is described as having views of the iconic bridge. The Skyline 1 Bedroom Suite is sold with views of Manhattan instead.
